children: Shares in fast-fashion giant Shein
fell in their ‌Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday, hurt by numerous setbacks that delayed its listing ​and undermined the foundations of its ⁠business.
Known globally for selling $5 tops ​and $10 dresses, Shein has been ​humbled by
and duty changes in the U.S. and Europe.
Here's a timeline of the Singapore-headquartered company's prolonged attempts to list:
JANUARY 2022
Shein revives New York listing plans. Its founder considers changing his citizenship to bypass tougher rules for offshore IPOs in China, Reuters reports.
It had first explored a U.S. IPO two years earlier but shelved it amid volatile markets and U.S.-China tensions.
FEBRUARY 2022
Shein pauses U.S. listing plans due to volatile capital markets amid Russia's invasion of Ukraine, sources say.
MARCH 2023
Shein seeks to raise about $2 billion in new funding, eyeing a U.S. listing in the second half of 2023.
MAY 2023
Two dozen bipartisan U.S. lawmakers urge the Securities and Exchange Commission to halt Shein's IPO plans pending forced-labour verification, Reuters reports.
JUNE/JULY 2023
Shein makes moves to register with U.S. regulators and talks to NYSE, Nasdaq and at least three banks about a New York listing, Reuters reports.
NOVEMBER 2023
Shein targets a $90 billion valuation, Bloomberg News reports. The company confidentially files for a U.S. IPO and lawmakers renew demands for forced-labour proof tied to its cheap clothing.
DECEMBER 2023
Shein opens talks with the London Stock Exchange about a possible listing in the United Kingdom, Sky News reports.
JANUARY 2024
Shein seeks Beijing's approval for a U.S. listing to meet new rules for Chinese firms going public abroad, Reuters reports.
FEBRUARY 2024

Republican then-U.S. Senator Marco Rubio asks the SEC to block a New York listing unless the company makes additional disclosures about its business operations and "the serious risks of doing business" in China.
The UK's then-finance minister Jeremy Hunt meets Shein's chairman as London courts the listing, Reuters reports.
MAY 2024

Shein steps up preparations for a London listing after regulatory hurdles and pushback from U.S. lawmakers for its New York float. Senior British lawmakers also question its suitability and demand scrutiny.
JUNE 2024
Shein meets the UK's Labour Party and confidentially files with Britain's markets regulator.
A human rights group and, in July, a campaign backed by British retail consultant and television personality Mary Portas, push to block the London float.
OCTOBER 2024
Shein holds informal investor meetings for the planned London IPO.
DECEMBER 2024
Britain's financial regulator delays approval to vet supply chains and legal risks; Shein weighs asking for a waiver on rules requiring 10% of shares sold to the public.
JANUARY 2025
Shein targets a London listing in the first half, but tells UK lawmakers it bars Chinese cotton in U.S.-sold goods after a senior lawmaker flags concerns to regulators.
FEBRUARY 2025
Shein is set to cut its valuation in a potential London IPO to around $50 billion, nearly a quarter less than its 2023 fundraising value.
The Financial Times reports the listing may slip into the second half after U.S. President
scraps the "de minimis" customs duty exemption on low-value e-commerce parcels.
Shein is under pressure to cut its valuation to about $30 billion, Bloomberg News reports.
APRIL 2025
Britain's FCA approves Shein's London IPO — but Chinese regulatory sign-off is still needed.
MAY 2025
Shein pivots to Hong Kong, dropping its London-focused public relations firms Brunswick and FGS in a sign the UK float is faltering.
JULY 2025
The company files confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO.
JULY 2026
China's CSRC approves the Hong Kong IPO.
AUGUST 2026
Shein launches its Hong Kong float.
The firm prices its Hong Kong IPO below the top end of its marketed range, raising ‌HK$13.60 billion ($1.74 billion) from the share sale, with a valuation around $26 billion.
SEPTEMBER 2026
Shares in Shein fall in their first day of Hong Kong trade.
Founder and CEO Sky Xu does not speak at the listing ceremony though later takes pictures with Shein employees on stage.
